title: Joseph and Aseneth — Hobah Edition
about: An ancient Jewish romance expanding Genesis 41:45, 50–52. It tells of Aseneth's rejection of idols, penitence, transformation, marriage to Joseph, and a later conspiracy involving Pharaoh's son. The work survives in several recensions and languages, so no single surviving witness can simply be equated with an original text.

translation.status: Hobah complete modern-English edition from a public-domain historical English witness
translation.base_text: E. W. Brooks, Joseph and Asenath: The Confession and Prayer of Asenath (1918), a public-domain edition drawing especially on the Syriac witness while discussing Greek and other versions
translation.method: The complete public-domain historical English witness is ingested at build time and conservatively modernized for Hobah. The content is retained rather than summarized. This is a Hobah edition of Brooks's historical witness, not a fresh critical translation of the Greek/Syriac archetype.
translation.confidence: High for preservation of Brooks's published witness; medium for reconstructing the ancient work because the recension history is complex
translation.notes: The 29-chapter narrative is retained as transmitted in the historical edition. Apparatus and modern editorial introduction are excluded from the reading text where the source permits reliable separation.
translation.license_note: Brooks's 1918 edition is public domain; the cited Internet Archive scan is treated as the distribution copy. Hobah modernization is newly prepared for this project.
